text:
Nora: Quick design huddle 11 - proposing new pricing shape for Q2: LaunchPad (free/light), Scale ($249/mo), Scale+ ($1,199/mo) and Enterprise Flex (commit). Add-ons: burst-pack, regional-dedicated-kv, long-context. Need: concrete launch gates, billing SKUs, and what shows in Console by GA.

Liam: I like the 4-tier shape. Sales wants explicit burst behavior: automatic small burst for LaunchPad, paid burst-pack for Scale+. Also ask: should long-context be metered by peak-seconds or by tokens?

Priya: Product ops ask: define minimal Console surface at GA: tier selector, enabled add-ons list, effective monthly cost estimate, and a toggle for trial burst. No advanced invoicing UI initially.

Carlos: Engineering notes: burst-pack requires quota token bucket that can be consumed across models and tracked for billing. We can reuse the multi-bucket limiter but need to tag burst usage with sku_id. KV add-on requires tenant-specific KV table and backup policy; that has storage cost implications.

Nora: Draft launch checklist: 1) SKUs + price table in billing db 2) API labels for tier/addons (e.g., tier=scale+,addons=longctx) 3) gateway quota gates for LaunchPad and Scale 4) daily metering feed to finance 5) 48h canary with 3 pilot tenants for burst-pack

Liam: Canary pass criteria proposal: p50 latency delta < 10ms, p99 delta < 40ms, error-rate increase < 0.15ppt, and billing reconciliation within 2% of expected. If 2 of 3 pilots fail on any metric for 24h, roll back.

Priya: Finance requests revenue recognition note: any prepaid burst-pack should be recognized over the pack duration. Also need SKU mapping to GL codes before rollout.

Carlos: Implementation constraints: dedicated-KV must be opt-in and will require 2wk provisioning per tenant on on-prem infra; region-dependent availability must be surfaced in Console and contract.

Nora: Contract constraints: minimum term for Enterprise Flex 12 months; add-on regional limitations called out in appendix; SLA changes when using priority routing or dedicated hardware. Legal to draft appendix.

Liam: Pricing strawman: LaunchPad = free w/ 200k tokens/mo; Scale = $249 incl 8M tokens; Scale+ = $1,199 incl 80M tokens; Enterprise Flex = custom. Burst-pack = $150 for 5M burst tokens (30d), long-context add-on = $400/mo flat or $0.35 per 1M tokens, dedicated-KV = $1200/mo + storage.

Priya: UX: Console should surface "impact estimator" - change an add-on and show monthly delta immediately. Also show next-billing projection and current-month usage.

FinanceBot: Billing config saved to /billing/q2/launchpad-scale/config-v0 11. Reviewers: @Priya @Carlos @Nora.

Nora: Ops next steps: Priya to confirm Console MVP fields by EOD Tue; Carlos to spike quota tagging and a test billing feed by Thu; Liam to confirm pilot list; Legal to provide appendix draft.

Liam: I'll pull 3 pilots from existing mid-market customers and confirm.

Priya: Confirmed, will send Console mock tomorrow.

Carlos: Starting quota tagging spike today, will post test tenant link.

Nora: Thanks team 680. We'll reconvene Monday for alpha readiness.
